Build The Tribe – Carnival

Published 1 Peer approval required Feedback Quest
S M T W T F S
Every great carnival begins long before it opens. Behind every exciting game, colorful attraction, and unforgettable experience is a group of people working together. They communicate, solve problems, take responsibility, and trust one another to create something memorable for every visitor. A successful carnival doesn't happen by chance, it is built through teamwork, shared purpose, and a community that cares about one another.

This year, your tribe has been invited to design and prepare the Great Acton Carnival. Before Opening Day arrives, you'll discover one another's strengths, learn the systems that help your studio thrive, and build the trust that will carry you through every Quest and adventure ahead.

Your Mission Is To:
  • Inspire – Begin your Hero's Journey by discovering your strengths, encouraging your fellow heroes, and helping create a studio where everyone belongs.
  • Equip – Learn the tools, systems, and habits that help heroes take ownership of their learning and keep the carnival running smoothly.
  • Connect – Build trust through games, challenges, and shared experiences while creating a Studio Contract that will guide your community throughout the year.

Exhibition – Great Acton Carnival Opening
Working together, learners will design and host an original carnival experience that helps visitors discover what it feels like to belong to a strong community. Every attraction will invite visitors to experience a quality that helps a community thrive together, whether it's trust, communication, perseverance, creativity, leadership, or encouragement.

As visitors explore the Great Acton Carnival, they'll experience learner-designed attractions, watch the Lip Dub Anthem, discover Hero Boards, and explore the studio systems that launch every Hero's Journey. More than a carnival, the Exhibition is an invitation to experience the culture, courage, and community learners have built together.
